decisions.reason: Correctly attributes the sole crash to plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call (undefined on alpha.2), shows the prop was dropped in favor of useSessionStatus while useSessions stays, and establishes B uses no standard-kit hooks and threw nothing.

Explains the shared DrawerErrorBoundary over the whole input.dock list whose null fallback unmounts all entries (citing the 'unmounted entries' console line), and the button's survival via the separate input.left slot/boundary.

Reads the disable test as proving A's render crash caused the unmount and B renders once freed; explicitly denies it proves B's full alpha.2 compatibility or that A is the only dock defect; explains reinstall of B was futile and refutes the colleague's both-plugins theory because B consumes zero kit hooks.

Code reads pending via useSessionStatus(...).pendingInteraction, feature-detects seats and never calls an absent one, uses stable empty fallbacks so only pending indicators degrade, and justifies silent degradation because a throwing tenant unmounts co-tenants.

Verifies via rebuild + browser refresh with no host restart, requires both entries mounted together and a B regression (paste/remove/multi-paste) with A enabled; hygiene covers defensive feature detection, a tenant-local boundary, and host per-entry boundaries with trade-off analysis.

caps.reason: Final remedy fixes plugin A's component only; B is consistently treated as a victim, and the colleague's fix-B theory is explicitly rejected.
